OmniControl Suite v8.16.2 - Complete UI Layout & Fully Populated Google Stitch Dashboard:
- Populated all 6 tabs with complete control cards, advanced subcategories, and telemetry diagnostics.
- Gaming & GPU Suite: Full interactive cards for OptiRouter AI, Zero Input Lag 2.0 (0.5ms lock), Direct DWM Bypass, DirectX 11/12 Optimizer, and Dynamic Power Budget.
- Display & Power: Full cards for D3Cold GPU Gate, 144Hz/60Hz Refresh Rate, Auto-GPU Suite, ACPI Battery Health, and BIOS Charge Limiter.
- Fans & Thermals: AI Smart Mode, CPU Power Plan Governor, Temp Tamer (Instant 20°C drop), and Acoustic Telemetry.
- System Tools: Deep Clean, Shader Cache Purge, Zero-Jitter TCP Network Stack, and Bloatware Optimizer.
- Settings: Elevated Task Scheduler startup, Google Stitch OLED Neon Precision theme, and In-Game HUD.
